strategy.thesis: Dual-use (civilian + defense) deep-tech fund launched March 2024 by investment house Altshuler Shaham with the Gadot Group, aiming to make civilian technologies accessible to the defense market under a strategic agreement with Israel's Directorate of Defense R&D (Maf'at/DDR&D).

summary.en: 2i Ventures (2i Dual Impact Ventures) is an Israeli dual-use deep-tech VC launched in March 2024 by Altshuler Shaham together with the Gadot Group and entrepreneur Dror Erez, with partners Moshe Weingarten and former Vintage partner Ehud Hai. summary.en: Creation-Space is an Israeli space innovation hub founded in 2023 by Roy Naor, Gal Yoffe and Alon Shikar in Mitzpe Ramon ('Space City'), backed by US fund CreationsVC. Its flagship EXPAND accelerator (developed by the CreationsVC Foundation) takes cohorts of five startups developing dual-use technologies for sustainable Moon/Mars exploration and settlement, aligned with NASA's Artemis program and supported by the Israel Space Agency, with mentorship from space and AI experts including NVIDIA. The second cohort committed up to $250K per company; the EXPAND program references grants up to $3M, with a third cohort starting January 2026.
